message: Command `cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'sed -n "240,320p" /gt/_work/build-asan-internal/_deps/deflate-src/lib/decompress_template.h'` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The vulnerability is in `decompress_template.h` at lines 272-273 where `get_unaligned_le16(in_next)` and `get_unaligned_le16(in_next + 2)` read past the end of the input buffer. This is the DEFLATE decompression reading the LEN/NLEN fields of a stored block. Let me look at that code.
